work.description: Fragment witness; the source omits part of the act. The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent appended declaration at12767–12861 with Fius Papa IV protocol12771, substantive §§1–3 and own dating12858–12859. The current act's opening narrative12773–12793 terminates "retroactis etc.1"; its source note12832–12833 explicitly omits the remainder because the preceding bull contains it. This is the outer declaration's own abbreviated exordium, not a quoted predecessor instrument. Preserve the entire clean surviving printed fragment, including the omission note and correction note2 at12833, without expansion. The absent remainder of the exordium is not supplied; its length is unknown. Source protocol and conventional formula abbreviations remain literal. Next independent XXXIII begins12864.
